lines.text: (a) Unable to calculate this data when baseline defined.
(b) Over 95% of employees covered by certification, excluding M&A.
(c) Senior leadership includes executives (excluding Executive Committee) and directors, as per Danone classification.
(d) Closing the gender pay gap equals to a target of +/-3% by 2025. The 2025 data does not include US employees.
(g) Key partners defined as being 10,000 dairy farmers and workers.
(h) Enabling due diligence to be deployed in Danone operations.
(i) E-learning designed in 2023 and launched in 2024.
(j) 96.9% completion achieved; remaining gap driven by practical issues leading to some training sessions being postponed.
(k) Suppliers with a direct commercial relationship with Danone (Tier 1), excluding farmers.
